_provenance.annotation_protocol: Manual annotation against rosbag2 RGB + LiDAR replay in RViz. Object included if visible in the outdoor evaluation scene and supported by RGB/LiDAR evidence; selected scene-level objects outside the traversed robot path are retained to measure trajectory-bound recall. Pose = manually corrected object centroid or representative navigation pose in world (map) frame, initialized from STCM output where available and corrected by hand. Coordinate system: world / map; same as STCM output. Match radius for evaluation: 1.5 m global, with outdoor per-label thresholds documented in configs/experiments/manifest.yaml.
_provenance.label_vocabulary: Same target_labels list as configs/experiments/manifest.yaml outdoor_livinglab variant: trailer, electric utility vehicle, electric wheelchair, pair of ramps, portable power station, rectangular table, trolley, electric scooter, cardboard box, basketball, chair, umbrella, traffic cone, prohibition sign.
_provenance.notes: This file originated as an STCM output container and was manually corrected into ground truth; the metadata/runtime fields originally retained as provenance leftovers have been stripped on 2026-05-08 to remove ambiguity. Canonical GT keeps 'rectangular table' distinct from 'trailer'; the manifest scoring alias 'rectangular table -> trailer' was a deliberate outdoor ambiguity/centroid-offset accommodation and should be reported with strict same-label scores or removed for conservative scoring. Four of 19 GT instances are outside the robot path / 3 m observation envelope; retaining them is an annotation choice that exposes trajectory-bound recall, not a detector-visible failure.
